body:
Background... 22 year old father, working as a janitor and going to school, life/ emotional situation during experience was far from ideal but this was part of my motivation for taking a substance (not the healthiest outlet for a negative mindstate but I digress).
Ht: 5'7
Wt. 128 lbs.
Extensive experience with various psychedelics, Phenethylamines, Tryptamines, and Dissociatives... DOC, HOT-7, Foxy-Methoxy, AL-LAD, MMDA, MXE, and 25-B to name a few obscure ones... Had dosed 4-ACO-DMT a week before and some Moxy 2 months prior to that but other than those indulgences and smoking weed religiously I have been drug free leading up to this experience.
7:21 PM... approx. 110 mgs of MXP/ 2-meo-diphenidine were ingested in a parachute
8:06 PM body high first making itself noticeable, very, very light
8:45 PM very mellow head feeling present along with a slow body buzzing
10 pm feeling quite robotic in movement with waves of different body highs that range from pleasurable crawling vibrations to feeling like I'm rushing through space, thoughts are becoming difficult to vocalize but only because the mechanics involved in moving my mouth seem so intriguing.
12:37 feeling quite odd still,  reminiscent of that whimsical mad hatter state of mind, walking and talking funny while periodically giggling to myself. The body high keeps feeling like it is pulling me through space and Rick and Morty was cryptic as ever... I have powerful sensations moving up and down my legs as I type and my vision has been distorted throughout. This drug is esoteric feeling .... there are powerful concepts made clear to me then they slip from my grasp.
This drug is esoteric feeling .... there are powerful concepts made clear to me then they slip from my grasp.
I feel like I am flying through space when I listen to music with headphones on and have other senses deprived, I have control over these sensations after awhile and experiment... crazy stuff I feel like I'm slowly falling then suddenly I'm flying forward through the abyss around me.
2 AM feeling good and energized, the more psychedelic effects of this have more or less resided leaving a stimulation similar to a small dose of K or MDMA. Despite this I am still able to go to sleep rather easily after and wake up feeling fine.
In conclusion I found this stuff to be rather entertaining, even profound ... I loved MXE while I could get it, and because I tried it before I had a chance to get some actual K the latter almost seemed insignificant compared to the former. But this stuff, cleverly pseudonymed MXP by these clever Canadian chemists, is on a different level than either of them, clear headed like k but much more powerful in action and longer in duration like MXE. At this dose it can get a little hectic.
'May your journeys be difficult so that they can become truly enlightening lessons'
